about: The secreta of the formulary “18th Sunday after Pentecost” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: O God, Who, through the gifts we exchange with You in this sacrifice, make us partakers of the one supreme Godhead, grant, we beseech You, that, as we have knowledge of Your truth, so we may fully live up to it. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God,
